name: Everett Street Apartments
description: Welcome to Everett Street Apartments. You'll be living here this summer with your Uncle Henry. Get to know your neighbors, learn a thing or two, and maybe solve a mystery.

0.name: read
0.requiresFail: You can't read it, but it might be in elven (2).
0.description: Thanks to your skill in reading Quenya, you can tell that it says, "the grumpy horseman likes to talk." I wonder what that means.

1.name: move
effects: It might be a coffee plant. Definitely needs water.
1.description: The pot scrapes against the floor as you slide it, revealing a key.

2.name: search
2.action: You rummage around in the cushions.

3.name: open
3.action: You try to open the cabinet.
3.requiresFail: Looks like you need a key to open it.
3.description: The key turns in the lock allowing you to open the cabinet. There's a bunch of puzzles inside.

4.name: open
4.description: And discover a secret passage. Wonder where it goes.

5.name: talk
5.description: Now that you mention it, I'm hungry. You hungry?

6.action: Can I go to the cellar?
6.name: talk
6.description: Sure. If you can find it.

7.action: Yeah, I could eat. What do you want?
7.name: talk
7.description: This is one of the great mysteries of the world. I have no idea. I kind of feel like having a coffee, though.

8.action: Can you teach me some Elvish?
8.name: talk

9.action: I want to know more about Elvish.
9.name: talk
9.description: I'm a decker not a school teacher. Besides, you have better things to do.

10.action: I wouldn't mind a nice vanilla latte.
10.name: talk

0.name: plant
0.description: It might be a coffee plant. Definitely needs water. It looks like it is sitting a bit unevenly.

1.name: key
1.description: It's rusty, and it doesn't look like it belongs to a door.

2.name: dresser
2.description: Uncle Henry painted it for you. Why he chose to make it pink is beyond you, but there you have it.

3.name: den
3.description: It squeaks when you open it.

4.name: bed
4.description: It's lumpy and piled with pillows and quilts. Not what you expected, but you got used to it.

5.name: poster
5.description: It has a photo of a cute little cat dangling from a shelf. It says, "Hang in there!"

6.name: TV
6.description: The size of a cabinet, Uncle Henry likes his TV old school. Still, there are plenty of interesting things to watch here.

8.name: couch
8.description: It smells funny, and beware of sinking fully into it.

9.name: remote
9.description: Lots of buttons. Possession of the remote is a power move unlike any other.

10.name: cabinet
10.description: I wonder what is in there.

11.name: puzzles
11.description: They're old and dusty, but someone would probably enjoy them.

12.name: coins
12.description: They probably fell out of someone's pocket.

14.name: den
14.description: I think I can hear the TV in there.

15.name: cabinet
15.description: Under the sink. There's probably a garbage can in there.

16.name: passage
16.description: Lined with bricks, there appears to be a light at the other end.

17.name: potatoes
17.description: A sack overflowing with eyed potatoes. Are they looking at me?

18.name: tunnel
18.description: It's a steep climb, but you can probably make it.

19.name: Uncle
19.description: He's got a well used look. Kind eyes. Smells like coffee and a hint of sweet tobacco.

20.name: Willow
20.description: Looking for the end of the circle.

21.name: sign
21.description: It says something in a strange language. If only you could read it.

23.name: front door
23.description: Leads to the hall of the 1st floor.

25.name: lobby
25.description: The way most people come into the building.

28.name: The Rappahannock
28.description: In there somewhere is your apartment.

0.name: your bed room
0.description: It isn't much, but it's yours.

1.name: the den
1.description: The TV is here. It is therefore the most interesting room in the apartment.

2.name: the kitchen
2.description: This is where the magic happens.

3.name: the cellar
3.description: It smells of earth and ancient vegetables.

4.name: the hallway
4.description: Hangout for some, route to elsewhere for others.

5.name: the lobby
5.description: It's kind of cozy in here. Lit by electric sconces, a couple of nice leather chairs sit on either side of a coffee table. There's some magazines laying on the table. Beneath it all a worn oriental rug partially covers black and white marble tiles.

6.name: Everett Street
6.description: A quirky little street filled with lots of nooks to explore.
